name: Stone Cairn Lake
summary: At Stone Cairn Lake in northeastern Elwynn, murlocs hold the southern shore. Renegade wizards camp beside Heroes' Vigil, a memorial to those lost in the First War.

sections.title: A Monument Besieged
sections.body: Families and pilgrims once crossed the calm lake waters to honor the dead at Heroes' Vigil. The stone memorial rises on the central island, marking the heavy loss of human life in the First War against the Orcish Horde. Now the island is hostile, and those who come to pay their respects must face the wizards' camp beside the monument.

sections.title: Shores of the Lake
sections.body: Aggressive murlocs hold Stone Cairn Lake's southern banks. Crude huts line the water, and the murlocs harass anyone who comes near. Rich mineral veins run through the hills and rocky outcrops around the lake, drawing prospectors and miners despite the dangers along the shore.

faq.q: Why is it called Stone Cairn Lake?
faq.answer: Stone Cairn Lake takes its name from Heroes' Vigil, a stone cairn on the central island honoring Stormwind's soldiers and civilians who died in the First War.

faq.q: Who is currently occupying the central island?
faq.answer: Renegade wizards and other renegades occupy the central island. They drive away pilgrims and build a fortified camp around the memorial.

faq.q: Why are murlocs gathered around the water?
faq.answer: A local murloc tribe has settled the southern shallows and riverbanks. They build huts along the waterline and claim the plentiful fishing waters as their territory.

faq.q: What is the memorial on the island called?
faq.answer: The memorial is called Heroes' Vigil. Its stone cairn is also known as the Stone of Remembrance.

angles.text: The hills and bluffs around Stone Cairn Lake hold one of Elwynn Forest's heaviest concentrations of copper deposits, drawing aspiring blacksmiths and engineers.
As a human, you can see the island as a memorial to Stormwind's people. It honors those lost when the kingdom fell in the First War.
